brief:
The Al-Zaytoun Club's karate academy in Gaza has become a refuge for children facing displacement and conflict, Palestine News Network reported. Beyond martial arts instruction, the dojo serves as a space where young people can pursue their aspirations despite the upheaval surrounding them.

The academy's role extends beyond training, offering displaced children a place of stability and normalcy during a period of profound disruption.
dek: GAZA / PNN / For the children training at Al-Zaytoun Club’s karate academy in the Gaza Strip, the dojo was more than a place to practise martial arts.
title: Gaza karate academy shelters displaced children amid war
